_meta.note: Structural regression golden. All 4 endpoints switched from a local 529-only withRetry to callClaudeWithRetry (parse-retry + truncation fail-fast). 21 annotation leaks stripped from primary output (caption text/tone, hashtag.tag, platform_name badge) — check:golden checks STRUCTURE not content, eyeball wording after prompt edits. adapt max_tokens 2000->3000 (adaptations scale with target count). Re-locked 2026-08-23 (v2): posting_schedule removed and hashtag categories dropped. Best-posting-times named days, hours and a rationale nothing retrieved, and a hashtag labelled trending is a claim about post volume nobody counted. not_sure_about is new — the list of visual details the captions are forbidden to assert. Re-locked 2026-08-23 (v3): not_sure_about is now empty for any request with no image, enforced in code. Uncertainty here comes from looking; a typed description contains only facts the person supplied, and listing one as uncertain then blocked the fact they gave us. This case is description-only, so an empty array is the correct output rather than a regression. Re-locked 2026-08-23 (v4): the main endpoint is now four stages, not one — observe (vision, image) → generate (NO IMAGE) → validate (NO IMAGE, adversarial) → repair only the fields that failed. image_read and not_sure_about are gone, replaced by observed[] and uncertain[]; prohibited_inferences is envelope scaffolding and is stripped before the response. The reason for the rewrite is that not_sure_about was prose: the model wrote an accurate list and contradicted it in the next field, through four prompt rewrites. Withholding the image from stage 2 is what makes it a mechanism rather than another instruction. Stage 3 logs PASS/FAIL on every call because a validator that has stopped working returns the same empty list as one that found nothing — scripts/caption-magic-envelope-test.js plants known violations to tell those apart, and is run BY HAND (two live calls), never in the hook. Validation is fail-open: it wraps a working answer and must never be able to drop it.
